declarations.description:
Renders markdown (CommonMark and GitHub-flavoured: tables, task lists, strikethrough, autolinks) plus TeX math and
Mermaid diagrams, safely and while it streams.

**Safe by construction.** The output is built from the parser's tokens as Lit templates from a fixed list of
elements; no markdown ever reaches `innerHTML`. Raw HTML in the source is shown as code, never interpreted. Links
and images only keep `http(s)`, relative and (links) `mailto:`/`tel:` URLs, after the optional `urlTransform`.
Images render as `c2-image`; `image-policy="click"` makes every image wait for a click (except `image-origins`),
which closes the image-URL data-exfiltration channel a prompt injection opens in model output.

**Streaming.** Feed it with `appendText(chunk)` (or by setting `value`) while `streaming` is set. The text is
revealed at a steady pace by the same controller as `c2-streaming-text`, only the block still growing is
re-rendered (finished blocks keep their DOM, so a selection survives), and the unfinished tail is healed: `**bold`
renders bold, a half-typed link shows its label, an unfinished image or diagram is held back, and an open code
fence shows as plain code until it closes. `reveal-end` fires once the stream has ended and the display caught up.

**Composed.** Closed code fences render through `c2-code-viewer` (highlighted, copyable), `mermaid` fences through
`c2-mermaid`, `$…$`, `$$…$$`, `\(…\)` and `\[…\]` through `c2-math`; each loads on first use. Their own `--c2-…`
variables, set on this element, style every block.

The source is the `value` attribute or a child `<script type="text/markdown">` (indentation stripped).

cssProperties.description: Inherits, so an answer takes the colour of the bubble or card it sits in.
cssProperties.name: --c2-markdown--color

cssProperties.description: Extra space above a heading that follows other blocks.
cssProperties.name: --c2-markdown__heading--margin-top

cssProperties.description: A link whose URL is still streaming in.
cssProperties.name: --c2-markdown__link__pending--color

cssProperties.description: Raw HTML from the source, shown as code.
cssProperties.name: --c2-markdown__raw-html--color

cssProperties.description: Fade-in of each new block while streaming. `0s` turns it off.
cssProperties.name: --c2-markdown__block--enter-duration

cssProperties.description: Longest the display may trail the received text while streaming.
cssProperties.name: --c2-markdown__reveal--max-lag

cssProperties.description: Time to release the rest once `streaming` turns false.
cssProperties.name: --c2-markdown__reveal--flush-duration

cssParts.description: Every bulleted, numbered or task list.
cssParts.name: list

cssParts.description: Every code block: a `c2-code-viewer`, or a plain `<pre>` while streaming or with `code="plain"`.
cssParts.name: code-block

cssParts.description: Raw HTML from the source, shown as inline code.
cssParts.name: raw-html

cssParts.description: Caret at the end of the text while it streams. Draws `--c2-markdown__caret--content`.
cssParts.name: caret

members.name: streaming
members.description: More text is coming: heals the unfinished tail, shows the caret and marks the element busy. False flushes and renders the final text.

members.name: reveal
members.description: `smooth` paces streamed text; `instant` shows each chunk as it arrives. Reduced motion always behaves as `instant`.

members.name: imagePolicy
members.description: `load` (default) loads images lazily; `click` makes each image wait for a click, except those from `image-origins`.

members.name: imageOrigins
members.description: Origins whose images load without a click under `image-policy="click"` (space-separated in the attribute).

members.name: urlTransform
members.description: Rewrites or drops link and image URLs after the protocol check: return a new URL (a proxy) or `null`.

members.name: math
members.description: Math delimiters: `dollar` (all of `$…$`, `$$…$$`, `\(…\)`, `\[…\]`), `bracket` (backslash forms only) or `off`.

members.name: breaks
members.description: A single newline becomes a line break, as most chat interfaces expect.

members.name: headingOffset
members.description: Shifts heading levels so a `#` inside a card is not the page's `<h1>`. Capped at h6.

members.name: headingAnchors
members.description: Gives headings GitHub-style ids and an anchor link shown on hover.

members.name: code
members.description: `viewer` renders closed code fences through `c2-code-viewer`; `plain` as a styled `<pre>` that never loads shiki.

members.name: controller
members.default: new StreamRevealController(this, { maxLag: DEFAULT_MAX_LAG, flushDuration: DEFAULT_FLUSH_DURATION, onRevealEnd: () => this.dispatchEvent(new Event('reveal-end', { bubbles: true, composed: true })), })

members.name: hydrating
members.description: Upgraded over a server-rendered shadow root: the first render repeats the server's source so Lit can hydrate.

members.name: value
members.description: Markdown source received so far. Setting a value that extends the current one appends to the stream.

members.name: text
members.description: The markdown source received so far (same as `value`).

members.name: appendText
members.description: Adds a chunk to the stream.

members.name: clear
members.description: Clears the source and the reveal.

events.description: Fired once per stream, when `streaming` is false and the display has caught up with the received text.
events.name: reveal-end

type.text: CustomEvent<{ href: string; external: boolean; event: MouseEvent }>

events.description: Cancelable. A link was clicked; cancel it to route the link yourself or confirm before leaving.
events.name: link-click
